description: Ship traffic through one maritime chokepoint as of its latest published count: status, the mean of the last 7 calendar days to latest_date against normal and how many of those days are published, the newest daily count, how many final weeks it has been under 85% of normal, since when and against which normal, the last 8 weeks with their share of normal (figures only once a week is final), the last 14 published daily counts, the rule behind the status, and a link to its page on gaduin.com; with days, also every published daily count of that window (history). Counts are published in batches several days in arrears (weekly; Panama monthly): latest_date is the newest day counted, not today.

days.description: Also return history: every published daily count in this many calendar days ending on latest_date, with the weeks holding them (1-1130, the depth of the record kept). Omit for the reading alone.

slug.description: Chokepoint slug from list_chokepoints, e.g. suez or panama.

name: get_chokepoint_status
title: Chokepoint ship traffic
